page_title: NAN 1-2 LEN | Nantes v Lens 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Amady Camara (Nantes) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
90+2' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Wesley Said and he is replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Florian Thauvin (Lens) and his stunning dribble! He zig-zags through the defence and gets in front of the keeper. He faints to shoot and then suddenly strikes goalwards, but his effort misses the target by a whisker. Very unlucky for Florian Thauvin (Lens). This could have been a legendary goal. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
87' The substitution is prepared. Fabien Centonze (Nantes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolas Cozza.
87' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon is replaced by Amady Camara (Nantes).
87' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
83' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
81' 1 - 2 Matthieu Udol plays a terrific cross over to Wesley Said (Lens), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
80' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Lens players look gutted.
78' The Lens players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Bastien makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
77' Lens are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lens are going to take it.
74' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Wesley Said with a fine lofted pass.

73' Lens slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
72' Florian Thauvin (Lens) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
70' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
69' Substitution. Odsonne Edouard will be replaced by Rayan Fofana (Lens).
68' Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
67' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Lens force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
67' Lens are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
66' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Lens have a free kick.
64' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Nantes have a free kick.
61' It looks like Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Bastien won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
60' Here is a change. Bahmed Deuff is going off and Luis Castro gives the last tactical orders to Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes).
60' The game has come to an end for Youssef El Arabi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).
59' Mayckel Lahdo (Nantes) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
57' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.

56' The opposition back off Matthis Abline (Nantes) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
54' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
52' Great solo effort from Florian Thauvin (Lens)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.
50' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Florian Thauvin (Lens) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Anthony Lopes leaps to intercept the corner kick from Andrija Bulatovic (Lens).
45+4' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+2' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Substitution. Mayckel Lahdo (Nantes) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Bahereba Guirassy walks off.
44' It doesn’t look good for Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
43' The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
41' A player from Lens commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
41' Nantes concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.

38' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Robin Risser who easily stops the effort. Goal! Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
37' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) is going to take the penalty!
36' PENALTY! One of the players from Nantes is about to take a penalty kick.

34' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Ruben Aguilar showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Florian Thauvin (Lens) gets onto the scoresheets by sweetly heading it inside the left post – 0:1.
34' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
31' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
29' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nantes.
29' Lens show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
25' Lens are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. Lens earn a corner.
24' Malang Sarr (Lens) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Ruben Aguilar darts into free space to control the ball.
22' Nantes keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
20' Wesley Said (Lens) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
18' Florian Thauvin (Lens) beats several players before unleashing a long-range shot on goal that flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
17' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lens.
15' The Lens players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Anthony Lopes, who pulls off a stunning save!
12' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Risser comes off his line to gather the ball.

10' Matthieu Udol (Lens) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Lens will take a throw-in.

8' Matthis Abline (Nantes) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.

7' What a great chance for Malang Sarr (Lens). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
7' Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) steps up to send the ball in.

6' Florian Thauvin (Lens) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
3' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Benoit Bastien.
